articles.title: Trump endorses Netanyahu ahead of Israeli elections, calling him 'great warrior prime minister'

articles.title: Zelenskyy says US taking Putin's side would be 'historic mistake' - as Russian oil sites attacked
articles.description: Volodymyr Zelenskyy has warned that the US formally siding with Russia would be a "historic mistake" - as Ukrainian drones attacked oil facilities in St Petersburg.

articles.title: US condemns 'despicable' Israeli settler attack that seriously injured American photographer
articles.description: The US ambassador to Israel has condemned an attack by dozens of masked Israeli settlers on a village's harvest in the West Bank that left several people injured including an American photographer.
